meta_description:
132 likes, 3 comments - the_unconventional_ca on September 29, 2026: "Debt can give a growing company more time. But time only helps if the business can eventually generate enough cash to pay it back.

The Good Glamm Group story is a good example of why venture debt and cash flow need to be looked at together.

In a recent conversation with Aditya Singh, we got into what happens when the capital raised to fuel growth starts becoming a pressure on the business instead.

Because raising debt is one question. Having the cash flows to service it is another.

Full episode out now, link in bio
